CMOS four-input priority encoder
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
V0 d0 0 PULSE(0 3.3 50n 100p 100p 49.9n 100n)
V1 d1 0 PULSE(0 3.3 100n 100p 100p 99.9n 200n)
V2 d2 0 PULSE(0 3.3 200n 100p 100p 199.9n 400n)
V3 d3 0 PULSE(0 3.3 400n 100p 100p 399.9n 800n)
XDUT vdd 0 d2 d3 b1 d1 d2b b0 d0 valid astra_052_cmos_four_input_priority_encoder
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
